sourceTitle: 微软统一消费与商业 Copilot 组织，强化产品、平台与模型协同
author: Microsoft Corporate Blogs

blocks.text: Satya Nadella, Chairman and CEO, and Mustafa Suleyman, Executive Vice President and CEO of Microsoft AI, shared the below communications with Microsoft employees this morning.
blocks.zh: 萨特雅·纳德拉主席兼首席执行官,和穆斯塔法·苏莱曼,微软AI执行副总裁兼首席执行官,今天早上与微软员工分享了以下通讯.
blocks.en: Satya Nadella, Chairman and CEO, and Mustafa Suleyman, Executive Vice President and CEO of Microsoft AI, shared the below communications with Microsoft employees this morning.

blocks.text: I want to share two org changes we’re making to our Copilot org and superintelligence effort.
blocks.zh: 我想分享一下我们对于Copilot和超级情报工作的两件事。
blocks.en: I want to share two org changes we’re making to our Copilot org and superintelligence effort.

blocks.text: It’s clear a new era of productivity is emerging as AI experiences rapidly evolve from answering questions and suggesting code, to executing multi-step tasks with clear user control points. You see this in our announcements over the last couple of weeks, like Copilot Tasks and Copilot Cowork, agentic capabilities in Office, and Agent 365. As these experiences connect more naturally across agents, apps, and workflows, we have an opportunity to help customers spend more time on higher-value work and reduce manual coordination, while providing people with more agency and empowerment and organizations with the governance and security controls they need.
blocks.zh: 随着AI的经验从回答问题和提出代码迅速演变,用于执行有明确的用户控制点的多步骤任务。你看我们过去几周的公告里像Copilot任务和Copilot合作,办公室的代理能力,还有365号智能体由于这些经验更自然地连接到各代理人之间,应用程序,和工作流程,我们有机会帮助客户花更多的时间做价值更高的工作,减少人工协调,同时也为人们提供了更多的机构和权力,并为各组织提供了他们所需要的治理和安全控制。
blocks.en: It’s clear a new era of productivity is emerging as AI experiences rapidly evolve from answering questions and suggesting code, to executing multi-step tasks with clear user control points. You see this in our announcements over the last couple of weeks, like Copilot Tasks and Copilot Cowork, agentic capabilities in Office, and Agent 365. As these experiences connect more naturally across agents, apps, and workflows, we have an opportunity to help customers spend more time on higher-value work and reduce manual coordination, while providing people with more agency and empowerment and organizations with the governance and security controls they need.

blocks.text: To that end, we are bringing the Copilot system across commercial and consumer together as one unified effort. This will span four connected pillars: Copilot experience, Copilot platform, Microsoft 365 apps, and AI models. This is how we move from a collection of great products to a truly integrated system, one that is simpler and more powerful for customers.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们正在把整个商业和消费者的Copilot系统作为一个统一的努力结合起来。这将跨越四个相互关联的支柱:Copilot经验Copilot平台,微软365应用程序,和AI模型。这就是我们如何从一批伟大的产品 转向一个真正一体化的系统,更简单 更强大的客户。
blocks.en: To that end, we are bringing the Copilot system across commercial and consumer together as one unified effort. This will span four connected pillars: Copilot experience, Copilot platform, Microsoft 365 apps, and AI models. This is how we move from a collection of great products to a truly integrated system, one that is simpler and more powerful for customers.

blocks.text: Jacob Andreou will lead the Copilot experience across consumer and commercial, driving design, product, growth, and engineering, as EVP, Copilot, reporting to me. As CVP of Product and Growth at Microsoft AI, Jacob has accelerated our user-focused AI-first product making and growth framework. Prior to that, he was SVP at Snap, where he helped scale the company from its early days.
blocks.zh: Jacob Andreou将带领Copilot体验 跨越消费者和商业,驾驶设计,产品,增长,工程和工程,作为EVP,Copilot,向我汇报。作为微软AI产品与增长的CVP,雅各加快了我们以用户为重点的AI第一产品制作和增长框架.在此之前,他是SVP 在Snap,在那里,他帮助规模 从公司早期。
blocks.en: Jacob Andreou will lead the Copilot experience across consumer and commercial, driving design, product, growth, and engineering, as EVP, Copilot, reporting to me. As CVP of Product and Growth at Microsoft AI, Jacob has accelerated our user-focused AI-first product making and growth framework. Prior to that, he was SVP at Snap, where he helped scale the company from its early days.

blocks.text: Progress at the AI model layer is more critical than ever to our success as a company over the next decade and is foundational to everything we build above it. We are doubling down on our superintelligence mission with the talent and compute to build models that have real product impact, in terms of evals, COGS reduction, as well as advancing the frontier when it comes to meeting enterprise needs and achieving the next set of research breakthroughs. Mustafa Suleyman and I have been working towards this plan for some time, and he will continue to lead this high ambition work, reporting to me. Mustafa is uniquely qualified to drive this forward, with his deep focus and commitment to advancing the frontiers of model science, while also ensuring that human control, agency, and economic opportunity remain at the center of these advancements.
blocks.zh: AI模型层的进展对于我们作为一个公司在今后十年中的成功比以往任何时候都更为关键,并且对我们在它之上建立的一切具有基础意义。我们要用才华把超智能任务翻一番 并计算出能产生真正产品影响的模型以精华而言,减少COGS,以及推进满足企业需要和实现下一组研究突破的前沿。穆斯塔法·苏莱曼和我为这个计划工作了一段时间他将继续领导这一崇高的志向,向我汇报。穆斯塔法有独特的资格推动这个发展,高度关注并致力于推进模型科学的前沿,在确保人类控制的同时,机构,经济机会仍然是这些进步的中心。
blocks.en: Progress at the AI model layer is more critical than ever to our success as a company over the next decade and is foundational to everything we build above it. We are doubling down on our superintelligence mission with the talent and compute to build models that have real product impact, in terms of evals, COGS reduction, as well as advancing the frontier when it comes to meeting enterprise needs and achieving the next set of research breakthroughs. Mustafa Suleyman and I have been working towards this plan for some time, and he will continue to lead this high ambition work, reporting to me. Mustafa is uniquely qualified to drive this forward, with his deep focus and commitment to advancing the frontiers of model science, while also ensuring that human control, agency, and economic opportunity remain at the center of these advancements.

blocks.text: Ryan Roslansky, Perry Clarke, and Charles Lamanna will lead M365 apps and the Copilot platform. Together, Jacob, Ryan, Charles, Perry, and Mustafa make up the Copilot LT and over the next few weeks they’ll work to align the teams.
blocks.zh: 瑞安·罗斯兰斯基佩里・克拉克查尔斯·拉曼纳将领导M365应用软件和Copilot平台.{\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}我们一起 {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}我们一起雅各 雅各 雅各 雅各 雅各莱恩,查尔斯,佩丽,未来数周, 他们将努力调整队伍。
blocks.en: Ryan Roslansky, Perry Clarke, and Charles Lamanna will lead M365 apps and the Copilot platform. Together, Jacob, Ryan, Charles, Perry, and Mustafa make up the Copilot LT and over the next few weeks they’ll work to align the teams.

blocks.text: Our org boundaries will simply reflect system architecture and product shape such that we can deliver more coherent and competitive experiences that continue to evolve with model capabilities. And I am looking forward to how together we apply all of this to empower people, organizations, and the world.
blocks.zh: 我们的疆界将只是反映系统结构和产品形状,以便我们能够提供更加一致和具有竞争力的经验,这些经验将继续随着模型的发展而演变。能力。我期待着我们如何共同运用所有这些来增强人们的能力,各组织,和这个世界。
blocks.en: Our org boundaries will simply reflect system architecture and product shape such that we can deliver more coherent and competitive experiences that continue to evolve with model capabilities. And I am looking forward to how together we apply all of this to empower people, organizations, and the world.

blocks.text: Subject: A new structure for Microsoft AI
blocks.en: Subject: A new structure for Microsoft AI

blocks.text: Technology and the future of our industry will be defined by two things: frontier models, and the products through which they are experienced. For some time, I’ve been thinking about how we best tackle these huge challenges, and today I’m excited to be evolving our structure at Microsoft AI, ensuring we’re positioned to succeed in both.
blocks.zh: 技术与我们工业的未来将由两件事来决定:前沿模型,以及他们所经历的产品。有段时间我一直在想我们如何最好地应对这些巨大的挑战,今天我很高兴在微软AI公司 发展我们的结构,保证我们两边都能成功。
blocks.en: Technology and the future of our industry will be defined by two things: frontier models, and the products through which they are experienced. For some time, I’ve been thinking about how we best tackle these huge challenges, and today I’m excited to be evolving our structure at Microsoft AI, ensuring we’re positioned to succeed in both.

blocks.text: I came to Microsoft with an overriding mission: to create Superintelligence that delivers a transformative, positive impact for millions of people. This requires us to build frontier models, at scale, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Everything else follows from this. It’s the foundation for our future as a company. With our ambitious, long-term frontier scale compute roadmap locked, we now have everything we need to build truly SOTA models.
blocks.zh: 我带着压倒一切的任务来到微软:创造能带来变革的超级智能,对数百万人产生积极影响。这需要我们建立前沿模型,规模,将可能的界限推开。其他一切从此而来.这是未来公司的基础。带着我们的野心,长期边界尺度 计算路径图锁定,我们现在有我们需要的一切 建立真正的SOTA模型。
blocks.en: I came to Microsoft with an overriding mission: to create Superintelligence that delivers a transformative, positive impact for millions of people. This requires us to build frontier models, at scale, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Everything else follows from this. It’s the foundation for our future as a company. With our ambitious, long-term frontier scale compute roadmap locked, we now have everything we need to build truly SOTA models.

blocks.text: As you will have just heard from Satya, the next phase of this plan is to restructure our organization to enable me to focus all my energy on our Superintelligence efforts and be able to deliver world class models for Microsoft over the next 5 years. These models will enable us to build enterprise tuned lineages that help improve all our products across the company. They’ll also enable us to deliver the COGS efficiencies necessary to be able to serve AI workloads at the immense scale required in the coming years. Achieving all this will be a huge challenge, and I’m committing everything we have – and I have personally – to make it happen.
blocks.zh: 正如你刚刚从莎特雅那里听到的,这个计划的下一阶段是重组我们的组织,使我能够把全部精力都集中在我们的超级情报工作上,并且能够提供世界级的模型。微软未来5年.这些模式将使我们能够建立企业调制线,帮助改进我们公司的所有产品。也让我们能够实现COGS效率, 以在未来几年里,完成这一切将是一个巨大的挑战,我将尽我们所能, 我个人也这样做。
blocks.en: As you will have just heard from Satya, the next phase of this plan is to restructure our organization to enable me to focus all my energy on our Superintelligence efforts and be able to deliver world class models for Microsoft over the next 5 years. These models will enable us to build enterprise tuned lineages that help improve all our products across the company. They’ll also enable us to deliver the COGS efficiencies necessary to be able to serve AI workloads at the immense scale required in the coming years. Achieving all this will be a huge challenge, and I’m committing everything we have – and I have personally – to make it happen.

blocks.text: To that end, I’ve been working hard with other leaders in the background for a while now to define a strategy to unify Copilot by bringing together the Consumer and Commercial efforts as one. We all know this makes sense. Every user – whether at home or at work – will be able to enjoy the full benefit of what we are all building. Today, we’re combining these organizations into a single, unified Copilot org. Jacob has demonstrated himself to be an outstanding leader for the product experience and clearly has the product instincts, the operational range, and the conviction to make Copilot a great success.
blocks.zh: 为此,我与背景背景的其他领导人合作了一段时间, 制定统一Copilot的战略,我们都知道这有道理。每个用户,无论是在家还是在工作时,都能享受到我们所有建筑的全部好处。今天,我们...我们把这些组织合并成一个组织,统一Copilot操作规范。Jacob证明了自己是产品经验的杰出领导者 并且显然有产品的本能作战范围,以及让Copilot成功的决心
blocks.en: To that end, I’ve been working hard with other leaders in the background for a while now to define a strategy to unify Copilot by bringing together the Consumer and Commercial efforts as one. We all know this makes sense. Every user – whether at home or at work – will be able to enjoy the full benefit of what we are all building. Today, we’re combining these organizations into a single, unified Copilot org. Jacob has demonstrated himself to be an outstanding leader for the product experience and clearly has the product instincts, the operational range, and the conviction to make Copilot a great success.

blocks.text: Jacob will retain a dotted line to me, and I’ll stay directly involved in much of the day-to-day operation of MAI, attending Meetups, MMMs, LT, and supporting Jacob to drive all areas of product strategy. To ensure that the models we build and the products we ship are mutually reinforcing, we are establishing a Copilot Leadership Team that includes me, Jacob, Charles Lamanna, Perry Clarke, and Ryan Roslansky. This will enable us to focus our brand strategy, our product roadmap, our models and our core infrastructure as one to deliver the best experiences possible for all our users.
blocks.zh: 雅各会给我留一条线我将直接介入军事情报局的大部分日常工作,参加聚会,微米数,LT, (意大利语).并且支持雅各推动产品战略的所有领域.为了确保我们所建造的模型和我们所运送的产品相辅相成,我们正在建立一个Copilot领导小组 包括我,雅各 雅各 雅各 雅各 雅各查尔斯·拉曼纳佩里・克拉克还有瑞安·罗斯兰斯基这将使我们能够集中我们的品牌战略,我们的产品路线图,我们的模式和我们的核心基础设施是一体的,以便为我们所有用户提供尽可能最佳的经验。
blocks.en: Jacob will retain a dotted line to me, and I’ll stay directly involved in much of the day-to-day operation of MAI, attending Meetups, MMMs, LT, and supporting Jacob to drive all areas of product strategy. To ensure that the models we build and the products we ship are mutually reinforcing, we are establishing a Copilot Leadership Team that includes me, Jacob, Charles Lamanna, Perry Clarke, and Ryan Roslansky. This will enable us to focus our brand strategy, our product roadmap, our models and our core infrastructure as one to deliver the best experiences possible for all our users.

blocks.text: Thank you for everything you’ve done over the last few years. I know how hard everyone has been pushing and the sacrifices many of you have made to help the company adapt to this new era.
blocks.zh: 感谢您在过去几年里所做的一切。我知道每个人都在推动和牺牲 帮助公司适应这个新时代
blocks.en: Thank you for everything you’ve done over the last few years. I know how hard everyone has been pushing and the sacrifices many of you have made to help the company adapt to this new era.

blocks.text: We really do have an incredible opportunity to redefine Microsoft for this agentic revolution.
blocks.zh: 我们确实有一个不可思议的机会 来重新定义微软, 来进行这个代理革命。
blocks.en: We really do have an incredible opportunity to redefine Microsoft for this agentic revolution.

blocks.zh: 穆斯塔法的邮件稍作编辑,
